method: source SVG evenodd fills; paint-order visibility; piecewise monotone transverse surface correspondence, independent anterior/posterior; sample spacing 0.5 source units; no uniform dermatome strips or lesion inputs.
midlineEvidence: Existing BODY_LANDMARKS front/back head/neck/chest/waist/pelvis midline at x=200 on this 400-wide template only; explicit version-bound engineering convention, not a universal x=.5 assumption. Both source sides used directly; no mirrored front/back or sides.
limitations: Engineering surface registration, not medical review.
Source atlas differs from other publications and individuals; no diagnosis or matching.
Distal hands/fingers, feet/toes and anterior perineum not registered because pose/surface correspondence is not reliable.
Cranial V1/V2/V3 and ambiguous source C1/Co1 excluded; no unconfigured area means no sensation.
sourceOutline: Original whole-body base silhouette root/front:6/0/0, back:9/0/0; not union of dermatome fills (which contains narrow SVG paint seams). SVG evenodd fill rule respected.

sampling.note: Subpixel thresholds only; source path IDs and all exclusions recorded. No convex hull or buffer/make_valid repair. Closed visible paths use the source evenodd fill rule.
